### Decision ledger

**(a) Who controls the source?**
The source is `request` in `chrome.runtime.onMessageExternal.addListener(...)` (background.js L354–358). sourceReachability.browserFacts: externally_connectable controls which page origins/extension IDs can call the listener. Origin/url restrictions and manifest matches reduce scope but are not proof that attacker input is impossible.
